title: Step Up
brief:
The flag is up on a ledge, and walking into the side of a ledge gets you nowhere. You need to jump.

  • jump_right() — jump up and land one tile to the right, clearing a step one tile high.
  • jump_left() — the same, to the left.
  • jump_up() — jump straight up and land where you started.

Walk to the bottom of the step first, then jump up onto it.

Dropping down a ledge needs no jump at all — just walk off it.
